dedupe_keys.name: euspa eo and gnss market report biennial

description: The EUSPA EO and GNSS Market Report, published every two years by the EU Agency for the Space Programme and continuing the earlier GNSS Market Reports of the European GNSS Agency, estimates the size and growth of markets that rely on satellite navigation and Earth observation. The second issue, published in January 2024, covers 15 market segments, from consumer devices and road and automotive to aviation, maritime, rail, agriculture, emergency management, infrastructure and energy, and gives for GNSS the shipments, installed base and revenues of receivers and services, and for Earth observation the revenues from data and services, with forecasts about ten years ahead. It projects that GNSS devices in use will grow from 5.8 billion units in 2024 to almost 10 billion by 2034 and GNSS revenues from 300 to 580 billion euros, while the Earth observation market grows from 3.5 to 7.9 billion euros, with agriculture the largest share. Each segment chapter describes users, trends and the role of Galileo and Copernicus, and an annex sets out methods and data sources. Coverage: global markets with regional breakdowns. Format and access: PDF report of about 40 MB from EUSPA and the EU Publications Office, free. Caveats: modelled market estimates, not measured counts; methods change between issues. Simulation uses: dependence of economic sectors on GNSS for economic impact of outage scenarios, and receiver populations for exposure to jamming and space weather. Related records: the Galileo performance reports cover service delivery.
